head: 8 new weather apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These weather apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Weather charts this week, from Local Skies: Retro Weather to HIRKA: What to Wear Today.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store charts this week
means: If you're looking for something new in weather, these are small apps people are buying right now.
todo: Open each app's App Store page to check the price, in-app purchases and what it needs before you download.

list.name: Local Skies: Retro Weather
list.what: Shows the forecast like a classic TV weather report, with a ticker.

list.name: Mountain Visibility Forecast
list.what: Forecasts whether a mountain will be visible from where you are.

list.name: mote: weather in dots
list.what: Draws the sky and the forecast in dots, with the real moon phase at night.

list.name: AniMeteo: Pixel Art Weather
list.what: Puts a tiny animated pixel-art sky on your watch face.

list.name: Weathersive - Weather Insights
list.what: Compares today's weather with up to 30 years of history.

list.name: Weather, Actually
list.what: Explains the forecast in plain words, from Super basic to Nerd.

list.name: NoAd Radar
list.what: A weather radar with a dot-style map and no ads.

list.name: HIRKA: What to Wear Today
list.what: Tells you what to wear instead of the temperature.
